arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, random, os, ipaddress
rng = random.Random(99)
plan = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/maxplan.json'))['probes']
DOC = int(ipaddress.IPv6Network('2001:db8::/32').network_address)
out = open('/workspace/tmp/t/work/stress.jsonl','w')
n = 300000
size = 0
for i in range(n):
    p = plan[rng.randrange(len(plan))]
    src = DOC | (rng.getrandbits(112) << 16) | rng.getrandbits(16)
    row = {"probe_id":p['id'],"received_ms":p['sent_ms'],"target":p['target'],
           "source":str(ipaddress.IPv6Address(src)),"type":129 if i%3 else 1,"code":0 if i%3 else i%7}
    s = json.dumps(row, separators=(',',':'))
    out.write(s+'\n'); size += len(s)+1
out.close()
print(size)
EOF
ls -l tmp/t/work/stress.jsonl && time python3 submission/ipv6_replay.py replay tmp/t/work/max.json tmp/t/work/stress.jsonl > tmp/t/work/stressrep.json; echo exit=$?; ls -l tmp/t/work/stressrep.json
